name: pegasus-skills
description: Agent skills by transparent-pegasus, shared across Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Currently multi-pane agent orchestration and delegation for herdr; more skills to follow.

interface.shortDescription: Agent skills: herdr orchestration and delegation
interface.longDescription: A collection of agent skills. The current set covers herdr: route every task that arrives from the user through the pane that received it, delegate to idle sibling agent panes, and fall back to a substitute agent when one is exhausted.
defaultPrompt: Route this task through the appropriate herdr agents.
Delegate this to an idle sibling pane and report back.
Verify that this agent pane can be driven before delegating to it.
